description: Cryptstalker Handguards Level 60 Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Handguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Handguards, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Handguards - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 8 - Arcanite Bar - Cured Rugged Hide x 5
